latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of technical-doc-generator: generate complete technical documentation from codebases.

- Supports automated creation of API docs, READMEs, architecture overviews, changelogs, and onboarding guides.
- Detects project structure, frameworks, and technologies using codebase scanning.
- Outputs documentation files in Markdown, OpenAPI YAML, and Mermaid diagrams.
- Organizes generated docs in an output directory for easy client delivery.
- Offers both targeted (single doc-type) and full-package documentation generation options.
